title: Mileage and pickup impressions
summary: This topic mostly mentions good fuel mileage, with many other fragments simply noting pickup, commuting, access, or mileage context without a clear evaluation.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise good mileage, especially general fuel economy and motorway efficiency, with one fragment also noting excellent music access.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention pickup, commute use, mileage limits, low-mileage ownership context, or access questions without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: The topic mixes several loosely related subjects, including fuel mileage, pickup, commuting, infotainment access, and PCP mileage allowance questions.
Many fragments are very short or contextual, so the examples are insufficient to draw finer-grained conclusions beyond the explicit wording.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the broader review population.
